title: ephedra vulgaris var. minor
intro: Ephedra vulgaris var. minor, commonly known as Dwarf Ephedra, is a plant species belonging to the Ephedraceae family. It is a shrub-like plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including its ability to aid in weight loss, improve respiratory function, and boost energy levels. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Ephedra are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, increase heart rate, and dilate blood vessels, making it a popular ingredient in dietary supplements. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
